mentions.name: Onebliq
mentions.description: This service provides lightweight Azure cost visibility: it shows where Azure spend is going without requiring users to learn the ins and outs of Azure Cost Management, and sends alerts when something unusual happens with the root cause explained right away. It is in preview and open for early access.
mentions.problem: Understanding Azure spending requires learning all the ins and outs of Azure Cost Management, and unusual cost changes are hard to diagnose.
mentions.audience: People who deal with Azure day to day; early access available during preview
